headlines.title: Ex-Arsenal director of football Edu to advise Northampton
headlines.description: Nottingham Forest's former global head of football Edu will serve as a senior advisor to the new owners of Northampton Town.

headlines.title: US to host first Women's Club World Cup in 2028
headlines.description: Arsenal are named as one of the teams to compete at the inaugural Women's Club World Cup, to be hosted in the United States in 2028.

headlines.title: What are Real's attacking options during Vinicius Jr ban?
headlines.description: Real Madrid’s attacking options are expanding under Jose Mourinho, with Endrick, Yan Diomande and Carlos Espi offering fresh solutions in the final third.
